controls.title: Encryption at rest and key management
controls.requirement: All customer data at rest must be encrypted with AES-256. Keys must be AWS KMS customer-managed keys or held in CipherTrust Manager; provider-managed or default keys do not meet this requirement. Keys must rotate at least annually, and the key custodians must be named.
controls.applicability: Applies to every data store holding Confidential or Restricted data. Not applicable only if the classification document shows no such data at rest.
evidence: Architecture document, encryption at rest and key management section

framework_map.status: illustrative; not reviewed by a compliance owner

required_clauses: key management model stated (AWS KMS customer-managed keys or CipherTrust)

controls.title: RTO/RPO consistent with BIA tier, rollback path, immutable backups
controls.requirement: Recovery targets and rollback path are documented: the package states RTO and RPO and describes a rollback path for deployments. BIA consistency check: pilot scope.
controls.applicability: Applies to every production application with a BIA tier.

framework_map.status: illustrative; not reviewed by a compliance owner
glba_occ: Interagency Paper on Sound Practices to Strengthen Operational Resilience (2020)

controls.reviewer_role: ARB reviewer, Technology Resilience and Operations

controls.title: Security events to enterprise SIEM (Splunk)
controls.requirement: Security events from control plane, network flow, application audit and model invocation sources must be forwarded to the enterprise SIEM (Splunk). Retention must follow IS-STD-021. A named team must own the alerts raised on these events.
controls.standard: IS-STD-021 Security Logging and Monitoring v3.0 §4
evidence: Architecture document, logging and monitoring section

framework_map.status: illustrative; not reviewed by a compliance owner

controls.reviewer_role: ARB reviewer, Technology Resilience and Operations
required_clauses: security event sources forwarded to Splunk
